chunks.text: This month’s been a blur. I *might* end up bouncing between Shanghai and Hangzhou for work stuff, and I haven’t planned any of the fun parts yet.
Also, if I do go, it’d probably be Beijing to Shanghai first… the whole commute is already making me tired just thinking about it.

Hangzhou-wise, I was daydreaming about staying near the lake—West Lake State Guesthouse sounds like the kind of place I’d actually sleep well at. Check-in would be 2026-03-10 for 2 nights, under Liu Yang.
Yeah, that hotel plan sounds right—go ahead and lock it in under the guest name Liu Yang.
And in Shanghai, I’ve been craving Sichuan… Chuanfu Laozao keeps popping into my head. If it works out, 2026-03-21 at 19:00, just 1 person.
Actually yeah, let’s do it—reserve that dinner. Put it under Li Na, phone 13845678901.
If the timing lines up, I’d probably just grab that China Eastern flight MU5890 on 2026-03-22—passenger name Liu Yang. Sounds good to book that one too.
